snippet.title: Two Point Museum: Zooseum | First look!
snippet.description:
Curators, prepare for panda-monium!

Two Point Museum: Zooseum is coming to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on December 2nd! The Nintendo Switch 2 version is following in Q1 2026.

We've just released our full FAQ! Your hairiest questions, answered:
Admission fee? Lions, tigers, and bears? When do the park gates open?
Keeper and curators of all enclosures, wonder no more, for our Zooseum FAQ has hatched:  https://bit.ly/43DVvBT

Play Two Point Museum now on PC, Xbox X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185060/Two_Point_Museum/
Xbox X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9nfhrf1m4w3z
Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/two-point-museum-explorer-edition-switch-2/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009660
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/two-point-museum-b884ac

To see more Two Point Museum news and info, join us at:

Discord: https://discord.gg/twopointstudios
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/twopointstudios/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TwoPointStudios
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/twopointstudios/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@twopointstudios
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/TwoPointMuseum 
Forums: https://community.twopointcounty.com
